SELECT id, channel_code AS channelCode, package_id AS packageId, trigger_type AS triggerType, stats_task_ids_json AS statsTaskIdsJson, config_snapshot_json AS configSnapshotJson, incremental_after_time AS incrementalAfterTime, window_start AS windowStart, window_end AS windowEnd, status, total_scanned AS totalScanned, included_count AS includedCount, excluded_count AS excludedCount, review_count AS reviewCount, superseded_by_run_id AS supersededByRunId, error_message AS errorMessage, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt FROM access_swing_clean_run WHERE channel_code = #{channelCode} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
